# FacturXProfile

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Factur-X / ZUGFeRD 2.x semantic profile. Determines the `fx:ConformanceLevel` written to the XMP and constrains what the embedded invoice XML is expected to contain. BonniePDF does not generate or validate the XML against the profile schema — the profile is metadata about caller-supplied XML (see [`applyFacturX`](apply-factur-x.md)).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Values

- `Minimum`: MINIMUM — header + totals only. Not a valid VAT invoice on its own.
- `BasicWl`: BASIC WL (without lines) — header + totals, no line items.
- `Basic`: BASIC — line-level detail, subset of EN 16931.
- `En16931`: EN 16931 (COMFORT) — the full European semantic standard. The EU baseline.
- `Extended`: EXTENDED — EN 16931 plus additional business terms.
- `XRechnung`: XRECHNUNG — the German CIUS of EN 16931.
